notes.title: Build 114
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue with D*star shift menu button
-Tutorial messages will now be added to the notifications menu. Applies to new messages only.
-Improved Auto Advance and Time Bank functionality

notes.title: Build 113
notes.content: Addressed an issue involving high values of heroic gems

notes.title: Build 112
notes.content:
-The Time Bank slider has been replaced with an input field
-Minor UI adjustments
-Fixed an issue with Second Thoughts affinity
-The play for a certain number of day rewards have been redesigned

notes.title: Build 109
notes.content:
-Idle party members will no longer receive upgrades or appear on the upgrades menu
-Minor text corrections

notes.title: Build 108
notes.content:
-Fixed more text issues
-Fixed an issue involving time and timers

notes.title: Build 106
notes.content:
-When moving between levels, enemy attack timer will reset
-Some late game rewards are easier to learn
-"Loyalty Gems" are properly named to Faction Gems
-Fixed an issue with Halcyon menu buy buttons

notes.title: Build 105
notes.content:
-Added a button to turn Automation Upgrades on and off
-Fixed display issue
-Faction rewards should unlock more consistently
-Once per day activities (fortification stone extraction, and more) should properly reset at midnight without having to restart the game

notes.title: Build 103
notes.content:
-Minor fixes and adjustments
-Power Mastery has been removed due to issues. If you had any mastery points invested into it, you'll need to reset your mastery points to regain those points.
